description: Destroy one of an agent's conversation sessions. You cannot undo it yourself, so confirm with the user first, naming the session. The session leaves list_sessions and cannot be resumed at once. Its transcript is removed after a grace period; until then an operator can restore it. A session already deleted, or one of another agent, reports that it is gone and succeeds. Destroying the agent removes its sessions with it. Requires connecting a Valet account. Requires the Admin role.

name.description: The agent's name, as list_services shows it: the agent whose session to delete.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

session.description: The session id, as list_sessions names it.

name: destroy_session

already_gone.description: True when the session was already gone before the call, so nothing was destroyed. Absent when this call destroyed it.

kind.description: Always session: the kind of thing this tool destroys.

name.description: ID of the session destroyed, as passed in session.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

title: Delete an agent's session
